title: 1985 AMC 8 Problem 11
statement: A piece of paper containing six joined squares labeled as shown is folded along the edges of the squares to form a cube. The label of the face opposite the face labeled \(X\) is

solutions.text:
Fold the net so that \(X\) is the bottom face. Then \(U,\) \(V,\) \(W,\) and \(Z\) wrap around to become the four side faces.

The only remaining square, \(Y,\) becomes the top face, which is opposite the bottom face \(X.\)

Thus, the correct answer is E .
hints: Pick one face to be the front and fold the rest of the net around it
If \(X\) becomes the bottom face, track which square ends up on top
